content.caseIdentity: Caparo Industries plc v. Dickman, [1990] 2 AC 605 (House of Lords)
content.holding: Formulated the three-fold test for establishing a duty of care in novel situations: (1) foreseeability of harm, (2) proximity of relationship, and (3) that the imposition of liability is fair, just, and reasonable.
content.relevance: Restricted the over-expansion of negligence liability, particularly for pure economic loss.
